rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for the metal element or the metal itself.

example.english: This wire is made of copper.
example.jyutping: ni1 tiu4 sin3 hai6 jung6 tung4 zou6 ge3

rows.note: Use this colloquial Hong Kong term for a police officer, matching the slang sense of “copper.”

example.english: Stop making a fuss, the copper is here.
example.jyutping: m4 hou2 hai2 dou6 cou4 caai1 jan4 lai4 zo2

rows.note: Use this neutral term when referring to a police officer without the slang flavor of “copper.”

example.english: The copper has already cordoned off the street.
example.jyutping: ging2 caat3 ji5 ging1 fung1 so2 zo2 tiu4 gaai1

rows.note: Use this for the reddish-brown color associated with copper.

example.english: This wall is painted a copper colour, giving it a vintage feel.
example.traditional: 呢幅牆油成銅色，好有復古味。
example.jyutping: ni1 fuk1 coeng4 jau4 seng4 tung4 sik1 hou2 jau5 fuk6 gu2 mei6
